 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The repeated isolated color marks the centers for copies of the pattern.
    seen = set()
    components = Counter()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                size += 1
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen
                            and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            components[color] += 1 if size == 1 else 1000

    candidates = [color for color, n in components.items()
                  if n == counts[color] and counts[color] > 1]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    anchor_color = max(candidates, key=lambda color: counts[color])
    anchors = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] == anchor_color]

    pattern = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != anchor_color]
    if not pattern:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r,c,v in pattern); r1 = max(r for r,c,v in pattern)
    c0 = min(c for r,c,v in pattern); c1 = max(c for r,c,v in pattern)
    cr = (r0 + r1) // 2
    cc = (c0 + c1) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar, ac in anchors:
        for r,c,color in pattern:
            rr, col = ar + r - cr, ac + c - cc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                out[rr][col] = color
    return out
"
}
